ops.title: v13 activity_probe is disk-only (session_activity_probe(path)); breaks consumers with in-memory test fixtures — disk-back them
ops.body:
cc-transcript v13 deleted `probe_events(events)` and replaced it with `session_activity_probe(path: Path, *, waiting_tools=, human_facing_tools=)` in `cc_transcript/activity_probe.py`. It is **disk-only**: it hands the path string to the Rust extension, which reads AND parses the `.jsonl` itself. There is no in-memory-events entry point anymore.

**Migration trap for consumers:** any consumer that builds transcripts in memory for tests (path=None) can no longer exercise the probe — it silently reads a nonexistent/empty file and returns `is_waiting=False`. Production is unaffected because a real hook fire always has a transcript file path (`Session.path`).

**captain-hook migration (commit 143bf8f5, 2026-07-13):** `is_waiting` now calls `session_activity_probe(t.path, ...)` with a `t.path is None` guard. The waiting-condition test fixtures were in-memory, so they were disk-backed via a new `disk_fixture_session(messages)` helper in `captain_hook/testing/helpers.py` that materializes the synthesized `fixture_line` JSONL to a real `.jsonl` in the existing `fixture_file_dir()` (cached, atexit-cleaned tmpdir — the same mechanism as `materialize_file`), then `load_transcript`s it. `waiting_evt`/`waiting_stop_evt`/`make_messages_ctx` route through it. cc-transcript's own probe tests use the same pattern (`write(tmp_path, lines)` in `tests/test_activity_probe.py`).

**Latent gap still open (no covering test):** `captain_hook/testing/helpers.py` `input_to_event` (~line 402) still builds `TranscriptFixture` inline-test transcripts in-memory (`fixture_session(tf.messages)`, path=None). So a hook author writing a `Waiting()`-based INLINE hook test with a `TranscriptFixture` would get a silent wrong verdict (is_waiting always False). Unexercised today (captain-hook `.claude/hooks/` has zero `Waiting` usages; `run_inline_tests()` is pytest-covered and green). Fix = route that branch through `disk_fixture_session` with a regression test — do it deliberately since it flips path None→real for ALL TranscriptFixture inline tests. Related family release context: [[cc-family-v8-release-mechanics]].
